en: 1 Chronicles 4

p.src: 1  The sons of Judah: Perez, Hezron, Carmi, Hur, and Shobal.

ja: らは、ペレツ、ヘツロン、カルミ、フル、ショバル。
en: The sons of Judah: Perez, Hezron, Carmi, Hur, and Shobal.
u.src: 1  The sons of Judah: Perez, Hezron, Carmi, Hur, and Shobal.

p.src: 2  Reaiah the son of Shobal became the father of Jahath; and Jahath became the father of Ahumai and Lahad. These are the families of the Zorathites.

ja: レアヤはヤハテの父となり、ヤハテはアフマイとラハドの父となった。これらはツォラ
en: Reaiah the son of Shobal became the father of Jahath; and Jahath became the father of Ahumai and Lahad. These are the families of the Zorathites.
u.src: 2  Reaiah the son of Shobal became the father of Jahath; and Jahath became the father of Ahumai and Lahad. These are the families of the Zorathites.

p.src: 3  These were the sons of the father of Etam: Jezreel, Ishma, and Idbash. The name of their sister was Hazzelelponi.

ja: らは次のとおりである。エズレル、イシュマ、イドバシュ。
はハツェレルポニといった。
en: These were the sons of the father of Etam: Jezreel, Ishma, and Idbash. The name of their sister was Hazzelelponi.
u.src: 3  These were the sons of the father of Etam: Jezreel, Ishma, and Idbash. The name of their sister was Hazzelelponi.

p.src: 4  Penuel was the father of Gedor and Ezer the father of Hushah. These are the sons of Hur, the firstborn of Ephrathah, the father of Bethlehem.

ja: であるエフラタの長子フルの
en: Penuel was the father of Gedor and Ezer the father of Hushah. These are the sons of Hur, the firstborn of Ephrathah, the father of Bethlehem.
u.src: 4  Penuel was the father of Gedor and Ezer the father of Hushah. These are the sons of Hur, the firstborn of Ephrathah, the father of Bethlehem.

p.src: 5  Ashhur the father of Tekoa had two wives, Helah and Naarah.

ja: アシュフルには、ヘラとナアラという
en: Ashhur the father of Tekoa had two wives, Helah and Naarah.
u.src: 5  Ashhur the father of Tekoa had two wives, Helah and Naarah.

p.src: 6  Naarah bore him Ahuzzam, Hepher, Temeni, and Haahashtari. These were the sons of Naarah.

ja: ナアラは彼にアフザム、ヘフェル、テメニ、ハアハシュタリを
んだ。これらがナアラの
en: Naarah bore him Ahuzzam, Hepher, Temeni, and Haahashtari. These were the sons of Naarah.
u.src: 6  Naarah bore him Ahuzzam, Hepher, Temeni, and Haahashtari. These were the sons of Naarah.

p.src: 7  The sons of Helah were Zereth, Izhar, and Ethnan.

ja: らは、ツェレテ、イツハル、エトナン。
en: The sons of Helah were Zereth, Izhar, and Ethnan.
u.src: 7  The sons of Helah were Zereth, Izhar, and Ethnan.

p.src: 8  Hakkoz became the father of Anub, Zobebah, and the families of Aharhel the son of Harum.

ja: ハコツはアヌブ、ツォベバ、およびハルムの
en: Hakkoz became the father of Anub, Zobebah, and the families of Aharhel the son of Harum.
u.src: 8  Hakkoz became the father of Anub, Zobebah, and the families of Aharhel the son of Harum.

p.src: 9  Jabez was more honorable than his brothers. His mother named him Jabez, saying, “Because I bore him with sorrow.”

ja: って、彼をヤベツ と
en: Jabez was more honorable than his brothers. His mother named him Jabez, saying, “Because I bore him with sorrow.”
u.src: 9  Jabez was more honorable than his brothers. His mother named him Jabez, saying, “Because I bore him with sorrow.”

ja: 4:9 「ヤベツ」は、ヘブル語で「苦しみ」を表す言葉と音が似ている。
en: 4:9 “Jabez” sounds similar to the Hebrew word for “pain”.

p.src: 10  Jabez called on the God of Israel, saying, “Oh that you would bless me indeed, and enlarge my border! May your hand be with me, and may you keep me from evil, that I may not cause pain!” God granted him that which he requested.

ja: ヤベツはイスラエルの
とともにあり、私を悪から守り、
しみを引き起こすことのないようにしてください。」
en: Jabez called on the God of Israel, saying, “Oh that you would bless me indeed, and enlarge my border! May your hand be with me, and may you keep me from evil, that I may not cause pain!” God granted him that which he requested.
u.src: 10  Jabez called on the God of Israel, saying, “Oh that you would bless me indeed, and enlarge my border! May your hand be with me, and may you keep me from evil, that I may not cause pain!” God granted him that which he requested.

ja: 4:10 「神」と訳されたヘブル語は「אֱלֹהִים」（エロヒム）である。
en: 4:10 The Hebrew word rendered “God” is “אֱלֹהִ֑ים” (Elohim).

p.src: 11  Chelub the brother of Shuhah became the father of Mehir, who was the father of Eshton.

ja: ケルブはメヒルの父となった。メヒルはエシュトンの
en: Chelub the brother of Shuhah became the father of Mehir, who was the father of Eshton.
u.src: 11  Chelub the brother of Shuhah became the father of Mehir, who was the father of Eshton.

p.src: 12  Eshton became the father of Beth Rapha, Paseah, and Tehinnah the father of Ir Nahash. These are the men of Recah.

ja: エシュトンはベテ・ラファ、パセア、およびイル・ナハシュの
テヒナの父となった。これらはレカの
en: Eshton became the father of Beth Rapha, Paseah, and Tehinnah the father of Ir Nahash. These are the men of Recah.
u.src: 12  Eshton became the father of Beth Rapha, Paseah, and Tehinnah the father of Ir Nahash. These are the men of Recah.

p.src: 13  The sons of Kenaz: Othniel and Seraiah. The sons of Othniel: Hathath.

ja: らは、オテニエルとセラヤ。オテニエルの
en: The sons of Kenaz: Othniel and Seraiah. The sons of Othniel: Hathath.
u.src: 13  The sons of Kenaz: Othniel and Seraiah. The sons of Othniel: Hathath.

ja: 4:13 ギリシア語訳とウルガタ訳には「とメオノタイ」が加えられている。
en: 4:13 Greek and Vulgate add “and Meonothai”

p.src: 14  Meonothai became the father of Ophrah: and Seraiah became the father of Joab the father of Ge Harashim, for they were craftsmen.

ja: メオノタイはオフラの父となり、セラヤはゲ・ハラシムの
en: Meonothai became the father of Ophrah: and Seraiah became the father of Joab the father of Ge Harashim, for they were craftsmen.
u.src: 14  Meonothai became the father of Ophrah: and Seraiah became the father of Joab the father of Ge Harashim, for they were craftsmen.

p.src: 15  The sons of Caleb the son of Jephunneh: Iru, Elah, and Naam. The son of Elah: Kenaz.

ja: らは、イル、エラ、ナアム。エラの
en: The sons of Caleb the son of Jephunneh: Iru, Elah, and Naam. The son of Elah: Kenaz.
u.src: 15  The sons of Caleb the son of Jephunneh: Iru, Elah, and Naam. The son of Elah: Kenaz.

p.src: 16  The sons of Jehallelel: Ziph, Ziphah, Tiria, and Asarel.

ja: らは、ジフ、ジファ、ティルヤ、アサレル。
en: The sons of Jehallelel: Ziph, Ziphah, Tiria, and Asarel.
u.src: 16  The sons of Jehallelel: Ziph, Ziphah, Tiria, and Asarel.

p.src: 17  The sons of Ezrah: Jether, Mered, Epher, and Jalon; and Mered’s wife bore Miriam, Shammai, and Ishbah the father of Eshtemoa. 18  His wife the Jewess bore Jered the father of Gedor, Heber the father of Soco, and Jekuthiel the father of Zanoah. These are the sons of Bithiah the daughter of Pharaoh, whom Mered took.

ja: エズラの子らは、エテル、メレド、エフェル、ヤロン。メレドの妻はミリヤム、シャマイ、およびエシュテモアの父イシュバを産んだ。
エクティエルを産んだ。これらはメレドがめとったファラオの娘ビテヤの子らである。
zh: 以斯拉的兒子是益帖、米列、以弗、雅倫。米列娶法老女兒比提雅為妻，生米利暗、沙買，和以實提摩之祖益巴。米列又娶猶大女子為妻，生基多之祖雅列，梭哥之祖希伯，和撒挪亞之祖耶古鐵。
en: The sons of Ezrah: Jether, Mered, Epher, and Jalon; and Mered’s wife bore Miriam, Shammai, and Ishbah the father of Eshtemoa.
His wife the Jewess bore Jered the father of Gedor, Heber the father of Soco, and Jekuthiel the father of Zanoah. These are the sons of Bithiah the daughter of Pharaoh, whom Mered took.
u.src: 17  The sons of Ezrah: Jether, Mered, Epher, and Jalon; and Mered’s wife bore Miriam, Shammai, and Ishbah the father of Eshtemoa. 18  His wife the Jewess bore Jered the father of Gedor, Heber the father of Soco, and Jekuthiel the father of Zanoah. These are the sons of Bithiah the daughter of Pharaoh, whom Mered took.

p.src: 19  The sons of the wife of Hodiah, the sister of Naham, were the fathers of Keilah the Garmite and Eshtemoa the Maacathite.

ja: であるホディヤの妻の
en: The sons of the wife of Hodiah, the sister of Naham, were the fathers of Keilah the Garmite and Eshtemoa the Maacathite.
u.src: 19  The sons of the wife of Hodiah, the sister of Naham, were the fathers of Keilah the Garmite and Eshtemoa the Maacathite.

p.src: 20  The sons of Shimon: Amnon, Rinnah, Ben Hanan, and Tilon. The sons of Ishi: Zoheth, and Ben Zoheth.

ja: らは、アムノン、リンナ、ベン・ハナン、ティロン。イシの
らは、ゾヘテ、ベン・ゾヘテ。
en: The sons of Shimon: Amnon, Rinnah, Ben Hanan, and Tilon. The sons of Ishi: Zoheth, and Ben Zoheth.
u.src: 20  The sons of Shimon: Amnon, Rinnah, Ben Hanan, and Tilon. The sons of Ishi: Zoheth, and Ben Zoheth.

p.src: 21  The sons of Shelah the son of Judah: Er the father of Lecah, Laadah the father of Mareshah, and the families of the house of those who worked fine linen, of the house of Ashbea;

ja: ラダ、および上質の亜麻布を織る職人であるアシュベアの
en: The sons of Shelah the son of Judah: Er the father of Lecah, Laadah the father of Mareshah, and the families of the house of those who worked fine linen, of the house of Ashbea;
u.src: 21  The sons of Shelah the son of Judah: Er the father of Lecah, Laadah the father of Mareshah, and the families of the house of those who worked fine linen, of the house of Ashbea;

p.src: 22  and Jokim, and the men of Cozeba, and Joash, and Saraph, who had dominion in Moab, and Jashubilehem. These records are ancient.

ja: さらにヨキム、コゼバの
々、モアブを支配したヨアシュとサラフ、そしてヤシュビ・レヘムである。これらの記録は
en: and Jokim, and the men of Cozeba, and Joash, and Saraph, who had dominion in Moab, and Jashubilehem. These records are ancient.
u.src: 22  and Jokim, and the men of Cozeba, and Joash, and Saraph, who had dominion in Moab, and Jashubilehem. These records are ancient.

p.src: 23  These were the potters, and the inhabitants of Netaim and Gederah; they lived there with the king for his work.

ja: 職人であり、ネタイムとゲデラに
en: These were the potters, and the inhabitants of Netaim and Gederah; they lived there with the king for his work.
u.src: 23  These were the potters, and the inhabitants of Netaim and Gederah; they lived there with the king for his work.

p.src: 24  The sons of Simeon: Nemuel, Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, Shaul;

ja: らは、ネムエル、ヤミン、ヤリブ、ゼラ、シャウル。
en: The sons of Simeon: Nemuel, Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, Shaul;
u.src: 24  The sons of Simeon: Nemuel, Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, Shaul;

p.src: 25  Shallum his son, Mibsam his son, and Mishma his son.

en: Shallum his son, Mibsam his son, and Mishma his son.
u.src: 25  Shallum his son, Mibsam his son, and Mishma his son.

p.src: 26  The sons of Mishma: Hammuel his son, Zaccur his son, Shimei his son.

en: The sons of Mishma: Hammuel his son, Zaccur his son, Shimei his son.
u.src: 26  The sons of Mishma: Hammuel his son, Zaccur his son, Shimei his son.

p.src: 27  Shimei had sixteen sons and six daughters; but his brothers didn’t have many children, and all their family didn’t multiply like the children of Judah.

en: Shimei had sixteen sons and six daughters; but his brothers didn’t have many children, and all their family didn’t multiply like the children of Judah.
u.src: 27  Shimei had sixteen sons and six daughters; but his brothers didn’t have many children, and all their family didn’t multiply like the children of Judah.

p.src: 28  They lived at Beersheba, Moladah, Hazarshual,

ja: らはベエル・シェバ、モラダ、ハツァル・シュアル、
en: They lived at Beersheba, Moladah, Hazarshual,
u.src: 28  They lived at Beersheba, Moladah, Hazarshual,

p.src: 29  at Bilhah, at Ezem, at Tolad,

ja: ビルハ、エツェム、トラド、
en: at Bilhah, at Ezem, at Tolad,
u.src: 29  at Bilhah, at Ezem, at Tolad,

p.src: 30  at Bethuel, at Hormah, at Ziklag,

ja: ベトエル、ホルマ、ツィクラグ、
en: at Bethuel, at Hormah, at Ziklag,
u.src: 30  at Bethuel, at Hormah, at Ziklag,

p.src: 31  at Beth Marcaboth, Hazar Susim, at Beth Biri, and at Shaaraim. These were their cities until David’s reign.

ja: ベテ・マルカボテ、ハツァル・スシム、ベテ・ビルイ、シャアライムに住んでいた。これらはダビデの治世まで
en: at Beth Marcaboth, Hazar Susim, at Beth Biri, and at Shaaraim. These were their cities until David’s reign.
u.src: 31  at Beth Marcaboth, Hazar Susim, at Beth Biri, and at Shaaraim. These were their cities until David’s reign.

p.src: 32  Their villages were Etam, Ain, Rimmon, Tochen, and Ashan, five cities;

ja: 々は、エタム、アイン、リモン、トケン、アシャンの
en: Their villages were Etam, Ain, Rimmon, Tochen, and Ashan, five cities;
u.src: 32  Their villages were Etam, Ain, Rimmon, Tochen, and Ashan, five cities;

p.src: 33  and all their villages that were around the same cities, as far as Baal. These were their settlements, and they kept their genealogy.

u.src: 35  Joel, Jehu the son of Joshibiah, the son of Seraiah, the son of Asiel,

p.src: 39  They went to the entrance of Gedor, even to the east side of the valley, to seek pasture for their flocks.

en: They went to the entrance of Gedor, even to the east side of the valley, to seek pasture for their flocks.
u.src: 39  They went to the entrance of Gedor, even to the east side of the valley, to seek pasture for their flocks.

p.src: 40  They found rich, good pasture, and the land was wide, and quiet, and peaceful, for those who lived there before were descended from Ham.

ja: 和であった。以前そこに住んでいた者たちはハムの

ja: されたこれらの者は、ユダの
を打ち壊し、そこにいたメウニムを

ja: 彼らの一部、すなわちシメオンの
